title: Ade packs for his flight abroad
caption: Flying abroad to study? Keep your important documents in your HAND luggage, not the big suitcase ✈️ Passport, visa, admission letter, proof of funds, address... Save this checklist 📌 #studyabroad #travel #studentlife #checklist

scenes.backdrop: bedroom at night with an open suitcase, clothes everywhere and a passport on the bed

beats.title: DON'T PUT THESE IN YOUR SUITCASE!

beats.text: Quddus! My suitcase is ready. Passport, admission letter, all my documents, at the very bottom, under my jollof spices.
beats.say: Kuddus! My suitcase is ready. Passport, admission letter, all my documents, at the very bottom, under my jollof spices.
Ade! Take them out. Important documents go in your hand luggage, with you.
Big suitcases can get delayed or lost. And at immigration, they may ask for documents before you even get your bag.

scenes.backdrop: busy international airport check-in hall with departure boards and trolleys

beats.say: Keep this in your hand luggage, in one folder.
What if I lose the folder?
Save scanned copies on your phone and in your email. And share your flight details with family.
Check the customs rules of your new country first. Some foods are not allowed.
Documents in my hand, spices checked, and Ade is ready to fly!

scenes.backdrop: night city skyline with soft bokeh lights, purple and teal glow, cinematic

beats.text: Save this, and comment the country you're flying to.
